thread:
alice: Quick heads-up — planning a soft-unpin of runtime-v2.15 in the hosted fleet Monday 2026-04-06 03:00 UTC. Canary ran overnight and looks stable but we're seeing a small tail latency blip in eu-west. Want signoff on rollout windows and rollback triggers. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Current pinlist: runtime-v2.15 locked on: eu-west-1, onprem-score, na-east-slo. Canary pool: canary-us/20 nodes (v2.15).

benjamin: Heads-up: a handful of EU enterprise customers are on pinned capacity with 99.9% SLO. Need to notify Accounts + Support before we touch eu-west. If we exclude eu-west from unpin, we'll lose some of the cost benefit but safer.

carla: Agree with benjamin. Proposed plan: 1) Soft-unpin on na-east and canary pool only at 03:00 UTC. 2) Wait 2h of telemetry (p50/p95/p99 + errors + kv-cache miss). 3) If metrics stable, schedule eu-west phased unpin at 07:00 UTC.

alice: Sounds good. Add concrete rollback thresholds?

sre_josh: Suggest rollback if any of: p95 latency increases > 30% over baseline, absolute p95 > 180ms, or error_rate increase > 0.5% sustained for 5m. Also watch KV cache miss rate + OOMs. Rollback command:
`/deploybot rollback --service runtime --target v2.14 --reason "p95/regression" --until 3337774444`
If triggered, ops runbook: notify #incidents and set priority to P2.

carla: Add a soft-failover route for high-SLA customers during the eu-west step: route their traffic to dedicated reserved capacity (no unpin) via routing policy 'sla-hold'. That avoids immediate impact while we validate.

deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Scheduling prelim actions now. To schedule the soft-unpin you can run:
`deployctl pinlist update --remove runtime-v2.15 --scope canary,na-east --window "2026-04-06T03:00:00Z/2026-04-06T05:00:00Z" --note "soft unpin canary -> na-east, watch p95"`
I will leave eu-west untouched until explicit confirmation.

benjamin: I'll PM support and CSMs the short blurb once we have the final window. Draft for review:
"We will be soft-unpinning runtime-v2.15 from non-SLA pools on Mon 2026-04-06 03:00 UTC for performance rollout. EU enterprise reserved pools will be excluded from the initial step. We will monitor and follow up with schedule for EU after validation."

alice: Nice. Add a short release-note line under 'runtime' in the release tracker too: "v2.15 soft-unpin — staged rollout, monitoring p95 + errors, eu-west delayed for SLA customers."

carla: Also keep an eye on perf-regression eval set 5 (prompt group LLM.longseq). If rerank quality dips we'll pause.

sre_josh: I'll add automated telemetry alerts: p95 > 180ms OR delta_p95 > 30% -> pager to oncall. Also set an internal dashboard and a 2h burn window.

alice: OK — assuming deploy-bot schedule goes through, plan is:
- 03:00 UTC: unpin canary + na-east
- monitor 03:00–05:00 UTC
- 07:00 UTC: optional phased eu-west unpin if all green
Rollback thresholds as above.

deploy-bot: Schedule queued. Command used:
`deployctl schedule --action unpin --target runtime-v2.15 --targets canary,na-east --start 2026-04-06T03:00:00Z --end 2026-04-06T05:00:00Z --owner alice`
Will post a follow-up message when jobs enter execution state.

benjamin: 👍 I'll send the support/CS note after QA confirms wording.

carla: :thumbsup: I'll watch KV miss rate and perf evals. If anything noisy, I'll call abort.

alice: Thanks everyone. If no objections by EOD I'll proceed to finalize docs and trigger schedule.

benjamin: No objections here.

sre_josh: No objections — monitoring hooks in place.

alice: Great — I'll post the release-note PR and notify support in ~30m. :white_check_mark:
